_machines: Several machines can feed one dashboard: each syncs its ~/.claude into a directory named after it under claude_dir, and that directory name labels its rows. local_host names this machine's own rows when claude_dir is a single ~/.claude instead; empty means the system hostname. limits_host pins which machine's credentials file the plan-limits call reads; empty means the most recently written one, which is the one least likely to have expired.
_series_colors: Fixed model -> colour map for the stacked daily chart. Any model not listed here is grouped into 'Other'. These four hexes are the one 4-colour subset of the palette that clears every colour-blindness and contrast gate on the dark surface at all pair distances — re-validate before changing them.
